cases.name: construct-destroy-once
cases.source: int live;struct V{V()noexcept{++live;}~V()noexcept{--live;}virtual void f(){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct C:A,B{};struct D:C{};int main(){{D d;if(live!=1)return 1;}return live!=0;}

cases.name: construction-dispatch
cases.source: int log;struct V{V(){log=log*10+f();}virtual int f(){return 1;}~V(){log=log*10+f();}};struct A:virtual V{A(){log=log*10+f();}int f(){return 2;}~A(){log=log*10+f();}};struct P{long p;};struct D:P,A{D(){log=log*10+f();}int f(){return 3;}~D(){log=log*10+f();}};int main(){{D d;}return log!=123321;}

cases.name: construction-secondary-dispatch
cases.source: int seen;struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct A:virtual V{A(){V&v=*this;seen=seen*10+v.f();}int f(){return 2;}};struct B:virtual V{B(){V&v=*this;seen=seen*10+v.f();}int f(){return 3;}};struct D:A,B{int f(){return 4;}};int main(){D d;V&v=d;return seen!=23||v.f()!=4;}

cases.name: construction-rtti
cases.source: namespace std{class type_info{public:bool operator==(const type_info&)const;};}int bad;struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct A:virtual V{A(){V&v=*this;if(!(typeid(v)==typeid(A)))++bad;}};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;return bad;}

cases.name: nested-shared-vptr
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(7){}virtual int f(){return x;}};struct A:virtual V{int f(){return x+1;}};struct B:virtual A{};struct C:virtual A{};struct E:B,C{};struct D:E{long guard;D():guard(11){}};int main(){D d;V&v=d;return v.f()!=8||d.guard!=11;}

cases.name: virtual-nonvirtual-tail
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(7){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct P{long y;P():y(11){}};struct B:P,A{};struct D:virtual B{int z;D():z(13){}};int main(){D d;A&a=d;return a.x!=7||d.y!=11||d.z!=13;}

cases.name: copy-complete-from-base
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct P{long y;};struct D:A,P{long z;};int main(){D d;d.x=7;A&a=d;A copy(a);return copy.x!=7;}

cases.name: copy-base-skips-shared
cases.source: struct V{int x;V(int i=3):x(i){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct P{long y;};struct D:P,A{D(const A&a):V(9),A(a){}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;D d(a);return d.x!=9;}

cases.name: copy-nested-shared
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;d.x=7;D copy(d);return copy.x!=7;}

cases.name: assign-complete-base-view
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct P{long y;};struct D:A,P{long z;};int main(){D d,e;d.x=7;e.x=1;A&a=e;A&b=d;a=b;return e.x!=7;}

cases.name: delegating-base-entry
cases.source: struct V{int x;V(int v=3):x(v){}};struct A:virtual V{A():A(4){}A(int n):V(n){}};struct P{long p;};struct D:P,A{D():V(9){}};int main(){A a;D d;return a.x!=4||d.x!=9;}

cases.name: inherited-base-entry
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{int y;A(int n):y(n){}};struct B:A{using A::A;};struct P{long p;};struct D:P,B{D():B(7){}};int main(){D d;return d.x!=3||d.y!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-parameter
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};int read(A a){return a.x;}int main(){A a;a.x=7;return read(a)!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-indirect
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};int read(A a){return a.x;}int main(){A a;a.x=7;int(*p)(A)=&read;return p(a)!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-constructor
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B{int y;B(A a):y(a.x){}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;B b(a);return b.y!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-conversion
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B{int y;B(A a):y(a.x){}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;B b=a;return b.y!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-inherited
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B{int y;B(A a):y(a.x){}};struct C:B{using B::B;};int main(){A a;a.x=7;C c(a);return c.y!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-virtual
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct I{virtual int read(A a){return a.x;}};struct P{virtual void f(){}};struct D:P,I{int read(A a){return a.x+1;}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;D d;I&i=d;return i.read(a)!=8;}

cases.name: byvalue-member-pointer
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B{int read(A a){return a.x;}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;B b;int(B::*p)(A)=&B::read;return (b.*p)(a)!=7;}

cases.name: byvalue-multiple
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};int read(A a,int n,A b){return a.x+n+b.x;}int main(){A a,b;a.x=7;b.x=11;return read(a,3,b)!=21;}

cases.name: byvalue-lifecycle-hidden
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{int y;B(A a):y(a.x){}};struct C:B{C(A a):V(),B(a){}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;C c(a);return c.y!=7||c.x!=3;}

cases.name: base-initializer-virtual-access
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(7){}};struct B{int y;B(int v):y(v){}};struct A:virtual V,B{A():B(x){}};struct P{long p;};struct D:P,A{};int main(){D d;return d.y!=7;}
